SET PastaProjeto TO $'''C:\\Users\\caued\\Dev\\Projetos\\painel-logistico'''
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDateTime
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: CurrentDateTime CustomFormat: $'''yyyy-MM-dd''' Result=> DataHoje
Scripting.RunDOSCommand.RunDOSCommand DOSCommandOrApplication: $'''rotina_diaria.bat''' WorkingDirectory: PastaProjeto StandardOutput=> CommandOutput ExitCode=> CommandExitCode
IF CommandExitCode > 2 THEN
    EXIT Code: 0 ErrorMessage: $'''Falha ao atualizar a base: %CommandOutput%'''
END
File.ReadTextFromFile.ReadText File: $'''%PastaProjeto%\\dados\\resumo_kpis.json''' Encoding: File.TextFileEncoding.UTF8 Content=> ConteudoJson
Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: ConteudoJson CustomObject=> Kpis
System.RunApplication.RunApplication ApplicationPath: $'''%PastaProjeto%\\PainelLogistico.pbix''' WindowStyle: System.ProcessWindowStyle.Normal ProcessId=> AppProcessId
WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindow.ToOpenByTitleClass Title: $'''PainelLogistico''' Class: $'''WindowsForms10.Window.8.app.0.32fa273_r10_ad1''' FocusWindow: False) FOR 120
UIAutomation.SetWindowState.SetState Window: appmask['Window \'PainelLogistico\''] State: UIAutomation.WindowState.Maximized
Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''   powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"%PastaProjeto%\\scripts\\refresh_pbi.ps1\"''' ScriptOutput=> PowershellOutput
IF NotStartsWith(PowershellOutput, $'''OK''', False) THEN
    EXIT Code: 0 ErrorMessage: PowershellOutput
END
UIAutomation.FocusWindow.FocusByTitleClass Title: $'''PainelLogistico''' Class: $'''WindowsForms10.Window.8.app.0.32fa273_r10_ad1'''
WAIT 5
Workstation.TakeScreenshot.TakeScreenshotOfForegroundWindowAndSaveToFile File: $'''%PastaProjeto%\\relatorios\\Painel_%DataHoje%.png''' ImageFormat: System.ImageFormat.Png
MouseAndKeyboard.SendKeys.FocusAndSendKeysByTitleClass Title: $'''PainelLogistico''' Class: $'''WindowsForms10.Window.20008.app.0.32fa273_r10_ad1''' TextToSend: $'''   {Control}({S})''' DelayBetweenKeystrokes: 10 SendTextAsHardwareKeys: False
WAIT 5
UIAutomation.CloseWindow.CloseByTitleClass Title: $'''*PainelLogistico*''' Class: $''''''
WAIT (System.WaitForProcess.ProcessToStop ProcessName: $'''PBIDesktop''') FOR 60
IF Kpis['alerta'] = True THEN
    Email.SendEmail.AuthenticateAndSend SMTPServer: $'''smtp.gmail.com''' Port: 587 EnableSSL: True Username: $'''cauedasilva.slv@gmail.com''' Password: P'' AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False SendFrom: $'''cauedasilva.slv@gmail.com''' SenderDisplayName: $'''Robô Painel Logístico''' SendTo: $'''cauedasilva.slv@gmail.com''' Subject: $'''[Painel Logístico] %Kpis['mensagem']%''' Body: $'''  Resumo dos últimos 30 dias (%Kpis['periodo']%):

  OTD: %Kpis['otd']%  (meta: %Kpis['meta_otd']%)
  OTIF: %Kpis['otif']%
  Lead time médio: %Kpis['lead_time_medio_dias']% dias
  Pedidos em aberto atrasados: %Kpis['pedidos_em_aberto_atrasados']%
  Pior transportadora: %Kpis['pior_transportadora']['transportadora_id']%

  Relatório em PDF anexo.''' IsBodyHtml: False Attachments: $'''%PastaProjeto%\\relatorios\\Painel_%DataHoje%.png'''
END
